faq.q: Do I need Power BI Desktop?
faq.a: No, to do this course. The DAX window runs in your browser on a built-in model. Power BI Desktop is a free Windows application; if you have it, you can repeat the model and DAX exercises there, and the Power Query, report-building and Service lessons describe exactly what to click.

faq.q: Is the DAX engine the real one?
faq.a: It is a practice engine that follows DAX's rules for filter context, relationships, CALCULATE, iterators and the core time-intelligence functions, and it says so when you use something it does not support (for example ALLSELECTED, RANKX or USERELATIONSHIP). Measures that run here use real DAX syntax and work in Power BI.
Power Query (M), building report pages and the Power BI Service. They are explained with scenarios and practised with sorting and writing activities, because they need the desktop app.
Comfort with a spreadsheet. SQL for Data & Business or Advanced Excel for Data Analysis in this category help, but are not required.
Finishing every module and the final assessment marks the course complete on your GrowQR profile. It is not a Microsoft certification.

activities.title: Margin % with DIVIDE
activities.objective: Write a ratio measure safely with DIVIDE.
activities.scenario: [Total Margin] is ready-made. Define **Margin %**: the margin as a share of sales, using DIVIDE so that a cell with no sales shows blank, not an error.

Compare categories: which has the best margin?

activities.title: List revenue with SUMX and RELATED
activities.objective: Use an iterator to calculate per row, reading a price from a related table.
activities.scenario: List revenue is what each sale would have earned at the **list price**: quantity times the product's price, even if a discount was given. Define **List Revenue** with SUMX over Sales and RELATED to read the price from Products.
steps: SUMX(Sales, ...) walks the Sales rows.
Inside, multiply Sales[Qty] by RELATED(Products[Price]).
Compare the matrix with [Total Sales]: the difference is the discount.

activities.title: Share within category
activities.objective: Keep one filter and remove the others with ALLEXCEPT.
activities.scenario: Define **Share in Category**: each product's sales as a share of its **own category's** sales, so the products in a category add up to 100%.
steps: The numerator is [Total Sales].

Check that each category's products add up to 100%.

activities.title: The executive scorecard
activities.objective: Combine variables, time intelligence, a ratio and SWITCH in one measure.
activities.scenario: Executives want one status word per region and year. Define **Scorecard**: 'No prior year' when there is no last-year figure; 'Star' when growth is at least 20% and the margin is at least 34%; 'Steady' when growth is zero or more; otherwise 'Watch'. [Total Margin] and [Sales LY] are ready-made.
steps: VAR growth = DIVIDE([Total Sales] - [Sales LY], [Sales LY]).
VAR margin = DIVIDE([Total Margin], [Total Sales]).
RETURN SWITCH(TRUE(), ISBLANK(growth), ..., growth >= 0.2 && margin >= 0.34, ..., growth >= 0, ..., ...).
